plugin.name: Japanese Lyrics Source
plugin.description: Searches Japanese lyrics only and automatically adds furigana to kanji. Lyrico's TTML export includes tts:ruby annotations. Lyrics source only: no metadata or cover search. Only Japanese lyrics are returned; lyrics in Chinese or other languages never appear in search results.
config.pure_digits.title: Add furigana to numbers
config.pure_digits.summary: When on, plain numbers such as 2020 get furigana. Numbers with a unit such as 7月 or 2日 always do.
